broken: The login check accepts any token starting with "local-", and unknown ids fall back to a default "Learner" account instead of being rejected.
impact: Any client can access every protected endpoint without an account, and reads/writes data under a shared default identity.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: sent "Authorization: Bearer local-banana" -> server returned 200 with a default user profile + progress.
fix: Issue signed tokens (HMAC) mapped to real user ids; return 401/404 when the id is unknown. Never fall back to a default account.
test: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer local-banana" http://localhost:4000/api/user/progress -> now 200, must be 401.

broken: Passwords are stored unhashed in local mode and are returned verbatim in the signup, login and /me responses.
impact: If the store or any API response is exposed or sniffed, credentials leak in cleartext.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: signup and /me both echoed "password":"password123".
fix: Hash with bcrypt/argon2; never serialize the password field in any JSON response. (Supabase mode already hashes via admin.createUser.)
test: Sign up in local mode and inspect the response body for the raw password.

broken: GROQ_API_KEY only exists in the git-ignored backend/.env.local. A fresh clone has no key.
impact: Every AI route (writing, vocab, exam, conversation) returns 503 "Server is missing: groqApiKey".
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: reproduced the 503 for all four AI routes.
fix: Document the key requirement in README + .env.example; add a startup warning when the key is absent.

broken: .env and .env.local are loaded with CWD-relative paths, so the secrets only load when the server is started from the backend/ folder.
impact: Process managers, test harnesses, or deployments launched from another folder silently lose all secrets -> confusing AI outages.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: same code returned 503 groqApiKey from a different working directory, worked when CWD = backend/.
fix: Resolve env paths relative to the module (import.meta.url) or fail fast with a clear error.
test: Start "node src/index.js" from the repo root instead of backend/.

broken: UI says "Write at least 250 words", but the client only blocks under 25 words and the backend only requires 150 characters (~25 words). When the 40-min timer hits 0 it just stops counting; work is never auto-submitted.
impact: Undersized essays get scored with unreliable band estimates; a user can lose work silently at timeout.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: a ~30-word essay passed validation and was accepted for scoring.
fix: Enforce 250 words on both client and server; decide timer-expiry behaviour (auto-submit or clear warning).

broken: The query applies .limit(1) BEFORE choosing randomly, so the "random" drill is sampled from at most one row. The ?pillar= filter shares the same flaw and difficulty is never surfaced.
impact: Users effectively see a single drill; pillar/difficulty filters do not work as intended.
evidence: Static + local-mode trace (local mode correctly uses the full array; Supabase mode is broken by the query shape).
fix: Fetch the candidate set (or a random offset) then pick randomly; return difficulty.
test: Call GET /api/drills/grammar?pillar=subjunctive repeatedly in Supabase mode -> same row.

broken: Mastery = correct && attempts >= 3, so the third attempt can mark a word "mastered" even if only the latest answer is correct. The feature promises "three correct uses".
impact: Words are falsely mastered; the dashboard "words mastered" stat is inflated.
evidence: Static: code path traced for both local and Supabase modes.
fix: Count actual correct uses (streak or cumulative corrects) instead of attempts.
test: Answer wrong, wrong, right -> currently mastered=true.

broken: Auth is hydrated only from localStorage and never revalidated with /api/auth/me on startup. Expired/stale tokens keep showing a logged-in user until a request fails.
impact: Users see a stale session; no refresh path or forced sign-out.
evidence: Grep confirmed /api/auth/me is never called by the frontend.
fix: On mount, if a token exists call /api/auth/me; on failure clear the session.
test: Inject a bogus token in localStorage and reload the app.

broken: The response is labeled this_week but the DB queries aggregate all rows with no date filter.
impact: Weekly chart, accuracy, and counts are lifetime totals and never reset each week.
evidence: Static: no created_at filter anywhere in dashboard.js.
fix: Add created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' to each aggregate.
test: Query /api/user/progress, wait a week, numbers never reset.

broken: The backend computes weak_areas/recommendations but the frontend never reads them. The Overview "Recommended for you" card is hardcoded to "subject-verb agreement" for every user.
impact: Personalized recommendations are shown to no one; every user sees the same suggestion.
evidence: Grep confirmed the frontend uses neither weak_areas nor recommendations.
fix: Wire Overview to weak_areas and render real recommendation text.
test: Complete a drill on a pillar; check the Overview recommendation changes.

broken: next_review is set on every attempt but never queried. "Word of the day" is chosen purely by calendar-day index (floor(time/86400000) % wordCount), so mastered words resurface and the "Spaced repetition" UI card does nothing.
impact: The learning science behind the feature is fake; mastered words come back at random.
evidence: Static: next_review is written but never read anywhere.
fix: Query next_review to select review words; implement a real SRS schedule.
test: Master a word, then wait for the calendar index to cycle back to it.

broken: The 12-day streak, Upgrade CTA, Vocabulary "3" badge, hero chart heights, "Next question" 45%/100% progress and the inert "View report" button are static. "Save this rule" and "End & review notes" only fire a toast.
impact: UI displays fake stats and dead buttons, misleading users.
evidence: Static: values are literals in main.jsx.
fix: Drive streak/badges/chart from real data; wire or remove dead buttons.
test: Click "End & review notes" -> nothing is saved or ended.

broken: Scenario hardcoded to job_interview; no session list, resume flow, or end summary. Local-mode history is an in-memory Map (lost on restart) and the frontend never reloads persisted history on refresh.
impact: Conversations cannot be resumed or reviewed after leaving the page.
evidence: Live-tested: AI stays in character and keeps context across turns (works); persistence/resume is the gap.
fix: Add scenario selection, persist session_id, reload history on mount, implement end-session summary.
test: Have a chat, refresh the page -> history resets to the opening line.

broken: Style rewrites are returned as grammar "errors". A clean sentence was flagged with two "errors" (style rewrites) and scored tone 40/100 as "informal".
impact: Users are told correct English is wrong, eroding trust in the app.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: "I am a software developer and I work on this project every day" -> flagged "As a software developer", "every day"->"daily", tone informal.
fix: Split true grammar errors from style suggestions; only render genuine errors as corrections; neutral tone scoring.
test: Submit a clean professional sentence in Writing studio.

broken: Submitting the exact copied context example is accepted as a great original answer. No originality/similarity check exists before or inside the Groq call.
impact: Students can copy the sample sentence and receive top marks; the "original use" promise is unenforced.
evidence: VERIFIED LIVE: verbatim example -> correct:true, sophistication 8/10.
fix: Add a string/embedding similarity guard against examples before calling Groq; instruct Groq to penalize near-duplicates.
test: Copy the on-screen example sentence and submit it.

broken: The dist/ build on disk has http://localhost:4000 baked in as the API URL.
impact: A deploy of the stale dist/ talks to a local address and breaks the live site.
fix: Rebuild with VITE_API_URL set before deploying.

broken: No automated tests, linter, or CI on either side.
impact: Nothing guards regressions; security bugs like F-01 can quietly return.
fix: Add Vitest + supertest, ESLint, and a GitHub Actions CI pipeline.

broken: Three routers mount under /api/feedback (writing, grammar, vocabulary) with no versioning.
impact: Fine today, but any future path overlap silently shadows an endpoint.
fix: Version the API (e.g. /api/v1/...) and give each router a unique prefix.

broken: Unused `feedback` mock constant and unused Play icon import remain. No URL router, so refresh always lands on Overview.
impact: Confusing code; users lose their current view on refresh.
evidence: Static: feedback constant is not referenced by any component.
fix: Delete the mock; add react-router or a simple hash router.
test: Click a module, refresh the page -> view resets.
